title: Counting Bits
description: DP on bits: counts[i] = counts[i >> 1] + (i & 1) — reuse the answer for half of i. O(n).

notes: `i >> 1` is integer divide by 2 — drops the lowest bit, which (i & 1) recovers.
counts[0] = 0 is the base case; the loop starts at 1.
Naive popcount per i is O(log i) → O(n log n) total; this DP is O(n).

questions.q: What does `i >> 1` compute for non-negative i?

options: The lowest bit of i (0 or 1)
Bits in i = bits in i/2 plus its last bit
Only works for powers of two

exercises.prompt: Fill in the bit-DP popcount table.

L3.prompt: Write `countBits(n)` returning an array where `counts[i]` is the number of 1-bits in `i` for i = 0..n. Use the O(n) DP `counts[i] = counts[i >> 1] + (i & 1)`. Log `JSON.stringify(countBits(5))`.
hints: Allocate counts of size n+1; base case counts[0] = 0.
`i >> 1` is i/2 floored; `i & 1` is i mod 2.
